info.title: Loyalty.lt Shop API
info.description: REST API for awarding loyalty points, managing cards, coupons and games from an e-commerce platform or POS. Every path is locale-prefixed with `lt` or `en`.

get.description: Connection details for the realtime channel, which speaks the Pusher protocol. The QR channels are public — the unguessable session id in the channel name is the secret — so no per-session token is issued. Subscribe to `qr-login.{session_id}` or `qr-card.{session_id}` and bind `status_update`.

post.summary: Register a purchase and award points
post.description: The main integration call. Records a purchase for a customer and awards loyalty points. Identify the customer by user_id or user_email. Points are calculated from order_total unless points is given explicitly. Use type=cancellation or refund to reverse an earlier transaction for the same order_id.

user_id.description: Customer user ID. Required unless user_email is given.

user_email.description: Customer email. Required unless user_id is given.

order_id.description: Your order reference. Must be unique per transaction.

order_total.description: Order total. Points are calculated from this when points is omitted.

points.description: Award this exact number of points instead of calculating from order_total.

loyalty_card_id.description: Loyalty card to credit. Resolved automatically when omitted.

points_redeemed.description: Points the customer spent on this order.

points_discount_amount.description: Discount value of the redeemed points.

description.description: Free-text note stored with the transaction.

cart_items.description: Purchased line items, used for product-level offers and reporting.

meta_data.description: Arbitrary key/value data stored with the transaction.

post.description: Send SMS message using partner API credentials with automatic billing

destination.description: Target mobile number to where the message is being sent

message.description: Message text to be sent via SMS. If longer than a single SMS, a long SMS will be sent

receipt.description: Delivery receipt requested. Receipt will be sent to default URL if receiptURL not provided

receiptURL.description: Callback URL for delivery receipt on completion of message

validity.description: Time when the message expires, in ISO 8601 format

validityMinutes.description: Number of minutes until message should expire. Instead of validity

scheduled.description: Time when delivery of the message will be attempted, in ISO 8601 format

marketing_consent.description: Whether the recipient has consented to receive marketing messages. If true, consent will be registered.

client_ip.description: The actual IP address of the end user/client (not your server). Required for GDPR compliance when registering consent.

client_user_agent.description: The user agent string of the end user's browser/device. Required for GDPR compliance when registering consent.

consent_page_url.description: The URL of the page where the consent was given. Helps track where customers opted in.

message.example: Rate limit exceeded. Try again later.

get.description: Get the delivery status of a sent SMS message

parameters.name: message_id

post.description: Register marketing consent for a phone number without sending an SMS. Useful for consent obtained via website forms or other channels.

phone_number.description: Phone number to register consent for

consent_given.description: Whether consent is given (true) or revoked (false)

consent_source.description: Source where consent was obtained (e.g., website_form, pos, app)

client_ip.description: The actual IP address of the end user/client. Required for GDPR compliance.

client_user_agent.description: The user agent string of the end user's browser/device. Required for GDPR compliance.

consent_page_url.description: The URL of the page where the consent was given.

has_marketing_consent.description: Whether user has given marketing consent

description.example: The name of the application displayed to users
